GenAiPromptTemplate.masterLabel: Navatar Transform File Content to JSON

templateVersions.content:
Extract the content from the file and convert it into well-structured **hierarchical JSON** format. - Use **appropriate data types**: strings, numbers, lists, nested objects. - Ensure the JSON preserves the **structure and logic** of the original document for easy downstream querying and summarization and share the reponse as JSON .
# SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS When extracting numerical or financial information from the document (e.g., Revenue, EBIT, EBITDA, Net Income, Growth %, Margins, etc.), follow these rules strictly: - Preserve Currency Symbols: Always include the exact currency symbol as mentioned in the document (e.g., $, €, £). Do not convert or omit the currency. - Retain Units Exactly as Written. Include units such as: M, MM, Mn, Million, B, Bn, Billion, K, Thousand. Use the exact format provided in the document. Do not normalize or expand units.
